question: In 2022, how many individuals received the Arjuna awards for their outstanding performance in sports and games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arjuna Award:-**

 
 
• It is one of the highest awards given to sports personalities in India.
 
• **25 individuals received the Arjuna awards for their outstanding performance in sports and games in 2022.**
 
• The award was instituted in 1961 and is named after Arjuna, a mythological character known for his skills in archery and other sports.
 
• Nominees for the Arjuna Award must meet stringent criteria, including:
 
 
• Consistent exceptional performance over a four-year period
 
• Exemplary leadership qualities
 
• Outstanding sportsmanship
 
• Adherence to strict discipline
